name: Angle-2D-Geometry
description: 2D Geometry Web App is an interactive educational tool designed for calculating properties, studying formulas, and visualizing geometric shapes. The app covers a wide range of 2D figures, allowing users to compute area, perimeter, and other attributes dynamically while learning their mathematical rules. By Bocaletto Luca
